name: Copilot usage
description: GitHub Copilot's monthly quota beside Claude's on the usage meter, read with gh's own sign-in (gh api /copilot_internal/user). Only on a desktop with copilot on PATH; nothing is read, and nothing drawn, otherwise. Its status line counts this month's premium requests from VS Code's own Copilot Chat logs on any desktop: files only, no sign-in.
summary: Shows how much of your monthly GitHub Copilot allowance you have used, next to your Claude usage.
places: Usage meter: a "Copilot" segment with the percent of your monthly allowance used
